svg.title: Sequence 1 — Donor sign-up with phone OTP

g.text: Sequence 1 — Donor sign-up with phone OTP
request code (rate limited per client and per phone)
TTL of outstanding code (60 s resend cooldown)
name, password, consent to legal documents
password policy, consent (no ticket spent yet)
Lua script: delete ticket only if hash matches (atomic)
(said only to someone who proved they hold the phone)
(mobile: in the body, kept in secure store)
